g.text: Wide-angle lens · two barrels — reviewed section
Glass: light blue | Spacers: green | Retainers: dark gray | Barrels/cells: case colors
G3 → spacer → G2 → G1 → front ring. G1 and G2
directly contact at the new peripheral bearing
Rear barrel: load from both ends
Object side: G5 → spacer → G4 → middle ring.
Image side: G6 → spacer → G7 → rear ring.
Finish both subassemblies and secure their rings
before mating the 10 mm pilot joint. The rear
barrel's front ring must be accessed before
3.27 / 2.34 mm long. The integral stop has a 1
mm aperture land and an image-side 45° relief
Front ring → G1 → G2 → spacer → G3 → front-
barrel shoulder. The two rear-barrel rings
G2/G3/G4/G7 have extended mechanical rims; the original clear-aperture sag is preserved. Both uncut barrel bodies have at least 4 mm minimum
Nominal demo geometry. No new aperture/ray check. Ports, threads, tolerances and preload require CAD/engineering review.
